title: Elevated WAN utilization
source: BYA sample procedure — replace with approved operational content
steps: Compare current load with normal traffic for the same business period.
Check loss, latency and error counters through approved read-only monitoring views.
Check planned transfers and change windows with the service owner.
Record evidence and request engineer review; do not change routing or QoS.

title: Interface evidence checklist
source: BYA sample procedure — replace with approved operational content
steps: Verify the sensor-to-interface mapping and measurement units.
Review operational state, discards, errors and recent flaps.
Compare peer observations if available. Missing data is not a healthy result.

title: Storage capacity review
source: BYA sample procedure — replace with approved operational content
steps: Verify free-space units, retention policy and planned ingest.
Compare recent growth with the same time on prior days.
Ask the platform owner to review capacity; do not delete files automatically.
